reason: Elements cleanup, cumulative since baseline 0.0.0 and superseding declaration 027-catalog-required-props (its deltas, and those of every declaration it supersedes, remain as declared there). (1) ki-indicator holds the bound its contract already declared. The catalog rejects more than 20 positions (the @maximum of count and current), but markup and scripts reach the element without the catalog and one dot renders per position: count="20000" built 20,001 nodes. The component now renders at most 20 positions, reading a single constant that a browser test pins to the maximum the generated manifest declares. A count above 20 renders 20 and exposes "<label>, <current> / 20"; a count from 0 to 20 is untouched. The only surface delta is the description of count on @kimen/elements, which now states that at most 20 positions render; type, default, minimum and maximum are unchanged. Zero removals, no root growth, no CSS or token change. Nothing is published yet (0.0.0, private).
